hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pages-edit-gate.sh  # on an edit to a served file or a build input, tells Claude to apply the update-pages skill

in=$(cat); msg=''; if echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*CLAUDE\.md"'; then msg='CLAUDE.md changed - the copy injected at session start is now stale; re-read the file before relying on project instructions.'; elif echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*(\.claude/settings\.json|plugins/directives-toolkit/(agents|commands|skills|hooks|scripts)/)'; then msg='Hook/agent configuration changed - it loads only at session start; takes effect next session, do not assume it is live.'; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$msg" "$msg"; fi; exit 0  # an advisory, never a block: JSON on stdout with exit 0 (exit 2 renders as a hook blocking error after an edit that succeeded)
